```{r}
#| label: setup
library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(Metrics)

# Load data
ins <- read.csv("insurance.csv")
ins <- na.omit(ins)
ins <- ins |> mutate(across(c(sex, smoker, region), as.factor))
```

1. Exploratory Data Analysis

```{r}
#| label: eda
# Visualizing log-transformed relationships
ggplot(ins, aes(x = smoker, y = log(charges), fill = smoker)) + geom_boxplot() + theme_minimal()
ggplot(ins, aes(x = age, y = charges, color = smoker)) + geom_point() + theme_minimal()

# Box-Cox to justify log-transformation
boxcox(lm(charges ~ age + bmi + children + sex + smoker + region, data = ins))
```

2. Model Development
```{r}
#| label: model-fitting

# Candidates
lm_full <- lm(log(charges) ~ age + sex + bmi + children + smoker + region, data = ins)

lm2 <- lm(log(charges) ~ age + I(age^2) + sex + bmi + I(bmi^2) + children + 
            smoker + region + age:sex + age:children + age:smoker + age:region + 
            sex:smoker + bmi:smoker + children:smoker + smoker:region, data = ins)

# Model selection using AIC
aic_results <- AIC(lm_full, lm2)
print(aic_results)
```

3. Model Diagnostics & Validation
```{r}
#| label: diagnostics
# Diagnostics for the best model (lm2)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(lm2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Normality test
shapiro.test(residuals(lm2))

# Cross-Validation
set.seed(999)
train_idx <- sample(1:nrow(ins), floor(0.7 * nrow(ins)))
train_data <- ins[train_idx, ]
test_data <- ins[-train_idx, ]

fit_train <- lm(formula(lm2), data = train_data)
preds <- exp(predict(fit_train, newdata = test_data))
rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((test_data$charges - preds)^2))
cat("Test RMSE:", rmse_val)
```

4. Final Prediction Table
```{r}
#| label: prediction
region_rep <- ins %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(age = mean(age), bmi = mean(bmi), children = mean(children), 
            sex = "male", smoker = "no")

preds_ci <- predict(lm2, newdata = region_rep, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)

final_table <- ins %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(Insurance_Charge = mean(charges), n = n()) %>%
  mutate(Lower_Limit = exp(preds_ci[, "lwr"]),
         Upper_Limit = exp(preds_ci[, "upr"]))

print(final_table)
```
